answer_1.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed method by randomly constructing 500 unseen problem generation prompts... using GPT-4o to evaluate generated problems across eight dimensions...
answer_1.outputs: Generated math problem statements with detailed solution steps and reasoning answers

answer_2.quote: We use GPT-4o to evaluate generated problems across eight dimensions with scores from 1-10... We also compute perplexity (PPL) and BERTScore to compare synthetic SFT data with human-written data.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4o as an external judge to assess the quality of generated math problems... InternLM2-7B-Reward is used to evaluate preference data pairs... The self‑play mechanism uses model A3 to compare solution consistency.
